bio.text: David Young is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 28 and has served in the Iowa House since 2023.
The Iowa Legislature's biography for the 90th General Assembly (2023) says Young was born in 1968 in Des Moines, lives in Van Meter, and has a B.A. in English from Drake University (1991).

It lists Young's earlier work as U.S. Congressman for Iowa's Third District (2015-2019), chief of staff to U.S. Sen. Charles Grassley (2006-2013), and staff roles for U.S. Sens. James Bunning (1998-2005) and Hank Brown (1993-1996).
